correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the full periodic Manhattan adjacency and exhaustively enumerated all 18,634 nonempty cliques with f-vector [49,588,2646,5488,5733,3136,896,98]. Fetched original CERTIFICATE.json (Git blob da20ff2a898fc0b79d3cc5164646cceaf87391e2, 9325 chronological events), and independently replayed every free-face pair against the current active face set: 9309 valid codimension-one pairs with unique maximal coface, sixteen distinct maximal critical faces, no remaining faces. The resulting critical dimensions are exactly one 0-cell, one 3-cell, fourteen 4-cells. Ordered free-face collapse gives an acyclic Morse matching; independent signed integral recursive projection of three-face boundaries gives all fourteen 4→3 attaching degrees exactly zero. No reliance on old VERIFY_OK: the full finite certificate was checked afresh. Each map S^3→S^3 has degree 0 and is nullhomotopic, hence the integral CW homotopy equivalence, rather than just mod-two Betti, follows.
residual_risks: The proof is specific to 49 vertices and inclusive radius 3; no claim for other grid sizes or scale values.
A matching with 14 zero integer Morse boundaries is sufficient here because there is exactly one S^3 3-skeleton; it would not by itself classify arbitrary higher-dimensional attaching maps.

value.rationale: Settles a precisely stated, natural and published missing homotopy-type case of a torus-grid Vietoris–Rips filtration. Its integral mixed-dimensional wedge distinguishes homotopy from previously known mod-two Betti numbers and yields an explicit portable finite certificate. The exact finite object is motivated by a named unresolved classification question, and the certificate upgrades homological data to genuine attaching-map information.
residual_risks: No general family or persistence/equivariant maps computed.
